text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer recognized my hard work and gave 
me the green light to run in the Oaks! I'm 
unequivocally on the Tiara route now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, I was late to that press 
conference, and I got scolded to give 
serious comments... It was just utterly 
disastrous...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My heart needs to mature even more to live 
up to the fans' feelings! I swear it upon 
this Princess☆Right Hook!
